NOT

mapper.select: SELECT m.memNum, m.memName, m.memGender, m.memBirthday, m.memPhone, m.memEmail, m.memAddr, m.memCreated, m.memUpdated, m.memProfile, m.memNote, lv.startDate AS voucherStartDate, lv.endDate AS voucherEndDate, CASE WHEN lv.endDate >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN '사용중' ELSE '미사용중' END AS membershipStatus, (SELECT SUM(pl.countChange) FROM pt_log pl WHERE pl.memNum = m.memNum) AS ptRemain, (SELECT e.empName FROM employee e WHERE e.empNum = (SELECT MAX(pl.empNum) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY pl.createdAt, pl.usageId) FROM pt_log pl WHERE pl.memNum = m.memNum)) AS trainerName FROM MEMBER m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT memNum, MAX(endDate) AS endDate, MAX(startDate) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY endDate, voucherId) AS startDate FROM voucher_log WHERE memNum = #{memNum} GROUP BY memNum ) lv ON lv.memNum = m.memNum WHERE m.memNum = #{memNum}
